title: Natural Language Inference
motto: "t entails h" means a human reading t would conclude h is true. NLI is the task of predicting entailment / contradiction / neutral. Boring on the surface, load-bearing in production.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: "t entails h" means a human reading t would conclude h is true. NLI is the task of predicting entailment / contradiction / neutral. Boring on the surface, load-bearing in production.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You built a summarizer. It produced a summary. How do you know the summary does not contain a hallucination?
You built a chatbot. It answered "yes." How do you know the answer is supported by the retrieved passage?

steps.title: Implement nli
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.

code.starter:
def label_entailment(p,h):
    return "entailment" if p==h else "unknown"
